content.text:
Why is this seq scanning. Index exists on (tenant_id, created_at desc), stats were analyzed an hour ago, table is ~40M rows.

```sql
select id, payload
from events
where tenant_id = $1
  and created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
order by created_at desc
limit 100;
```

```
Limit  (cost=0.00..184320.55 rows=100 width=612) (actual time=8123.442..8123.501 rows=100 loops=1)
  ->  Seq Scan on events  (cost=0.00..2211846.60 rows=1200 width=612)
        Filter: ((tenant_id = 17) AND (created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)))
        Rows Removed by Filter: 39982104
Planning Time: 0.212 ms
Execution Time: 8123.559 ms
```

tenant_id is bigint, param is passed as a JS number through pg. Cardinality on tenant 17 is about 900k rows. Row estimate of 1200 is nonsense.
